content.title: ‘Euphoria’: Rue Gets Interrogated By DEA Agents In Latest Season 3 Trailer
content.text: Skip to main content ‘Euphoria’: Rue Gets Interrogated By DEA Agents In Latest Season 3 Trailer UPDATED 3/30: The third season of Euphoria is fast approaching, and HBO kicked off the week with another trailer for the series’ anticipated return. In the trailer, embedded above, Rue (Zendaya) finds herself in a world of trouble yet again, this time being interrogated by Drug Enforcement Administration agents about some dealings in Mexico. Season 3 is set several years after the main characters have graduated from high school, marking a pretty significant time jump for the series. Monday’s trailer also gives new glimpses at where some of the other relationships between the core characters stand, including Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddie (Alexa Demie). Watch the full trailer above. The first trailer for Season 3, released in January, is at the bottom of this post. Watch on Deadline ORIGINAL 1/14: HBO has set the premiere date for the return of Euphoria for Season 3: 9-10 p.m. Sunday, April 12. New episodes will drop weekly on Sunday nights. A first look at the long-awaited third season is available via the trailer above. From Sam Levinson, the eight-episode Season 3 will feature a time jump that takes the Euphoria characters out of high school. It will follow a group of childhood friends who wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption and the problem of evil. Related Stories Returning series regulars include Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, Eric Dane, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Alexa Demie, Maude Apatow, Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry, Adewale Akinnuoye Agbaje and Toby Wallace. Colman Domingo, Dominic Fike, Nika King, Alanna Ubach, Sophia Rose Wilson, Melvin Bonez Estes, Daeg Faerch, Paula Marshall, Zak Steiner and Marsha Gambles are among the returning guest stars. RELATED: ‘Euphoria’ Unveils New Photos For Season 3: Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, Jacob Elordi, More New famous faces guest starring in Season 3 include Sharon Stone, Rosalía, Danielle Deadwyler, Marshawn Lynch, Anna Van Patten, Asante Blackk, Bella Podaras, Bill Bodner, Cailyn Rice, Christopher Ammanuel, Christopher Grove, Colleen Camp, Darrell Britt-Gibson, Eli Roth, Gideon Adlon, Hemky Madera, Homer Gere, Jack Topalian, James Landry Hébert, Jeff Wahlberg, Jessica Blair Herman, Justin Sintic, Kadeem Hardison, Kwame Patterson, Madison Thompson, Matthew Willig, Meredith Mickelson, Natasha Lyonne, Priscilla Delgado, Rebecca Pidgeon, Sam Trammell, Smilez, Trisha Paytas, Tyler Lawrence Gray and Vinnie Hacker. Zendaya in ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 HBO Production wrapped in November in Los Angeles, where the series was shot thanks in part to a $19.4M California tax credit. Euphoria returns four years after the show’s Season 2 run and is expected to be the conclusion of the series. RELATED: ‘Euphoria’ Season Finale: Character Meets Tragic End During S.W.A.T. Raid; Friendships Rekindle, Fizzle Out Deadline caught up with Domingo on the Golden Globes red carpet on Sunday, and he shared a short yet poignant teaser for the upcoming third season. “We’re gonna have a devastatingly gorgeous, epic season that I think is breaking the mold of television,” Colman shared. “I think it’s gonna become more cinema than television.” Regarding his character, who meets Zendaya’s Rue at an NA meeting and becomes her sponsor, Domingo said Season 3 would mine the depths of Ali Muhammed’s backstory. RELATED: 2026 Premiere Dates For New & Returning Series On Broadcast, Streaming & Cable Season 3 was shot on a new Kodak motion picture film stock in both 35mm and 65mm. Levinson and Marcell Rév collaborated closely with the company to commercialize the new stock in each format. Of note, Season 3 is also the first narrative television series to shoot a significant volume of 65mm film, providing for an expanded image on screen which mirrors the characters’ journeys out of high school into the wider, wilder world, according to HBO. Euphoria is created, written, directed and executive produced by Sam Levinson. Ashley Levinson, Sara E. White, Kevin Turen, Ravi Nandan, Drake, Adel “Future” Nur, Ron Leshem, Daphna Levin, Hadas Mozes Lichtenstein, Mirit Toovi, Tmira Yardeni, Yoram Mokady and Gary Lennon also EP.
